  • Method Details

    • title

      public EditDialog.Builder title(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component title)
      Title text shown at the top of the dialog. Required (this or the supplier).

    • title

      public EditDialog.Builder title(Supplier<net.minecraft.network.chat.Component> title)
      Title text read every frame the dialog is shown: the item it edits, say.

    • content

      public EditDialog.Builder content(PanelElement content)
      The controls, lenses onto your draft, shown under the title. Required. One element; put several in a vertical Flow. The dialog is as wide as it.

    • onSave

      public EditDialog.Builder onSave(Runnable onSave)
      Runs on Save: write the draft back and change the state that shows the dialog. Required.

    • onCancel

      public EditDialog.Builder onCancel(Runnable onCancel)
      Runs on Cancel and on Escape: close the dialog, leaving the draft unwritten. Required.

    • saveLabel

      public EditDialog.Builder saveLabel(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label)
      The Save button's label. Default "Save".

    • cancelLabel

      public EditDialog.Builder cancelLabel(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label)
      The Cancel button's label. Default "Cancel".

    • id

      public EditDialog.Builder id(String id)
      The Panel's id. Defaults to a generated "edit-dialog-N".

    • build

      public Panel build()
      Builds the dialog Panel, hidden until you show it with Panel.visibleWhen(java.util.function.BooleanSupplier).
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if title, content, onSave or onCancel is unset
